assets.name: campaign-challenges-atlas
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless 4-column by 2-row image atlas for seven existing small performance marketing problem cards. Generate exactly 8 equal rectangular tiles, perfectly aligned in a 4x2 grid, no gutters or borders or margins. Overall landscape 3840x1920 requested. Each tile is a premium photoreal 3D studio render on light neutral frosted background, centered compact objects occupying middle 60%, same lighting/materials/style. Row 1 left to right: (1) wasted advertising budget, gold coins falling past an empty glass lead funnel; (2) costly clicks, a polished cursor arrow beside tall gold coin stacks; (3) missing attribution tracking, disconnected translucent glass data nodes; (4) weak landing page, a glass browser panel with an outward exit arrow. Row 2 left to right: (5) wrong ad audience, a teal target with small orange audience discs outside the rings; (6) leads without follow-up, a closed cream envelope and small elegant amber clock; (7) scaling problems, violet rising bars interrupted by a small gap; (8) stable campaign growth, intact teal rising bars with small check. No writing or numerals, no logos, no watermark, no people, no drawn webpage, no decorative clutter. Very refined crisp tiny-use silhouettes, glass, matte lavender, ivory, teal and brushed gold. Equal 4x2 tile alignment is essential for CSS crop positions.
